title: 우편환법 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:19:0:00022:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 19 (Correction of Remitter's Information)
(1) If the remitter requests to correct or change the name, address, or other information of themselves or the recipient as stated on the postal money transfer request form according to Article 7 of the Act, they must present the confirmation of receipt to the post office. <Amended April 30, 2007>
(2) If the remitter, as stipulated in paragraph (1), is unable to present the confirmation of receipt, they must provide documents to prove their identity as the remitter.
(3) The post office, upon receiving the request under paragraphs (1) and (2), must verify the payment status of the regular money transfer online and, if the payment has not been made, must respond to the request.
(4) The remitter, as stipulated in paragraphs (1) and (2), must pay the fee as determined and announced by the Minister of Science, ICT and Future Affairs. <Amended July 31, 1998, March 3, 2008, March 24, 2013, July 26, 2017>
